stories.title: In Malaysia, DAP’s vote to stay in Anwar’s alliance secures stability – but at what cost?
stories.summary: A crucial ally of Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s ruling alliance voted on Sunday to stay in government, giving him breathing room after months of uncertainty over whether the biggest party in the coalition would remain in cabinet. But the Democratic Action Party’s (DAP) decision also raises the stakes for its own political survival.
